title: Explicit local coefficient functor and endpoint maps
statement: For UniformizerChernNormalizationData l Y [def-diagonal-uniformizer-chern-transport], define localFunctor on the derived category of completed modules on P=ProjectiveLine Y by composing completedP realization, integral scalar extension, quotient scalar extension, and finite realization eP [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference, def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-scalars, def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-realization]. Compose their specified unit isomorphisms to define localUnitIso, over abstract coefficients, and specialize its inverse as localUnitInv. Define localLine as the composite of their shifted positive-line endpoints, with the supplied QuotientLineRealization as last endpoint [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-quotient-line]. These are actual constructions; no Chern normalization or existence choice enters them. LocalChernNormalized(s,z) names the equation that localUnitInv followed by localFunctor(z) followed by localLine equals geoP1Comparison of geoP1EtaleChern with the supplied positive exponent and annihilator [sk-lem-geo-p1-cohomology]. This is an explicit predicate, not an asserted equation.

proof.text: Compose the four exact/derived coefficient functors. Compose the four unit isomorphisms by functorial image; their inverses give the inverse endpoint. Compose the shifted line maps in the same order, using the given quotient-line endpoint at the end. No theorem is assumed in these constructions. Name the displayed local positive Kummer equation as LocalChernNormalized.
